recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If the current Citation artifact needs review, inspect and update the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG source that now owns Citation rather than resurrecting retired core source.
issue_request: FHIR-36332 was a Published/Persuasive R5 CDS request to convert Citation.citedArtifact.relatesTo from RelatedArtifact to a BackboneElement, bind Citation.citedArtifact.relatesTo.type to RelatedArtifactTypeExpanded, and add reprint and reprint-of relationship codes.
initial_application: Commit 85447dc81219e2260d6dc9076f55b2f86ccf94bd applied the Citation.citedArtifact.relatesTo BackboneElement modeling and expanded terminology. Commit c306590de4d7deb3747fadab95e2b19b4d9c4636 then changed the expanded value set to compose the base related-artifact-type system plus a separate expanded code system containing only the extra reprint/reprint-of codes.
additional_context: FHIR-36039 created the RelatedArtifact FHIR-resource restrictions that prompted this Citation-specific exception. Current core no longer owns active Citation source: source/fhir.ini has no Citation resource entry and leaves related-artifact-type-expanded commented out, source/clinicalreasoning-evidence-and-statistics.html says Citation moved to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG, and commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed source/citation and related build entries.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested change was present in the R5 application, and the current core checkout has no active authoritative Citation or expanded-value-set source to edit.
